title: Web Automation Chains
summary: This module provides components for LLM-driven web automation, enabling an AI agent to interact with web pages. It includes a chain for generating browser commands and a crawler for executing these commands and extracting page content.

nodes.label: User Automation Objective
nodes.title: User's Goal
nodes.description: The high-level goal or task provided by the user for the web automation agent to achieve.

nodes.label: NatBot Chain
nodes.title: LLM-Driven Browser Orchestrator
nodes.description: The core chain that interprets the user's objective and current browser state to decide the next action to take in the web browser.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: AI Command Generator
nodes.description: An external Large Language Model that processes prompts from the NatBot Chain to generate specific browser action commands.

nodes.label: Generated Browser Command
nodes.title: Action Instruction
nodes.description: A specific instruction (e.g., 'click id=5', 'type text into id=10', 'scroll down') for the web browser to execute.

nodes.label: Web Page Crawler
nodes.title: Browser Interaction & Content Extractor
nodes.description: A component that uses Playwright to control a web browser, execute commands, and extract the current page's content and interactive elements.

nodes.label: Web Browser Instance
nodes.title: Controlled Browser
nodes.description: The actual web browser (e.g., Chromium) that is programmatically controlled by the Crawler to perform navigation and interactions.

nodes.label: Current Browser Content
nodes.title: Extracted Page State
nodes.description: The extracted textual and structural content of the web page, including visible elements and their attributes, used to inform the NatBot Chain's decisions.

groups.label: Web Automation Orchestration
groups.title: Orchestrates the overall web automation process
groups.description: This group represents the primary interface and control flow for driving web automation tasks based on user objectives.

groups.label: LLM-driven Command Generation
groups.title: Generates browser commands using an LLM
groups.description: This group focuses on the intelligent generation of browser actions by leveraging a Large Language Model.

groups.label: Web Page Interaction & Analysis
groups.title: Handles browser interaction and content extraction
groups.description: This group is responsible for physically interacting with the web browser, executing commands, and analyzing the resulting page content.

groups.label: Browser Environment
groups.title: Represents the external web browser system
groups.description: This group encapsulates the actual web browser instance that is being controlled and provides the environment for web interactions.
